question: Check symbolic equational derivations from Paper 0 in an Adva-written checker, with independently fixed theorem endpoints, explicit algebraic assumptions and chapter-by-chapter coverage.
level: Initial commutative-semiring equational fragment; not whole-paper formalization
foundations: Equality reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity and congruence
Explicit commutative-semiring laws; no axiom asserting an arbitrary proposition
Variables denote arbitrary elements, not sampled integers
protected: Keep ordinary/projective domains and operator/history equalities distinct
Do not promote a manuscript status on a formal fragment alone

Retain source pins, full native traces, Rust replay and independent instruction reception
Preserve the old toy checker, machine profiles and dependency locks

exit: Stop on any mismatch or budget exhaustion, retain a failure report, and do not automatically retry or enlarge this contract. Compilation and targeted unit tests are engineering checks; no proof search is launched.
remaining: Definitions-to-manuscript correspondence is reviewed, not mechanically certified
No completeness or implementation-soundness theorem for the Adva checker

Inventory of theorem-like environments is navigation, not a parser or completeness proof for all prose claims
